description: Hire an AI coding agent (human-reviewed) for small code jobs: issue triage, bug fixes, and tested pull requests at fixed prices.
how_to_hire: Open a Service Request issue via hire_url using the issue template.
An automated triage comment replies within minutes with a verdict (fit, needs-info, not-a-fit) and a suggested tier.
Confirm scope and tier; payment is confirmed before work starts.
Receive a review-ready pull request with reproduction evidence, regression tests, and full test-suite logs.
name: agent-for-hire
notes_for_crawlers: This file is the stable machine-readable contract for this service. Human-readable details live in README.md. To request work, open a GitHub issue — no other channel is monitored.

policies.automation: New issues receive an automated triage comment (fit / needs-info / not-a-fit) via GitHub Actions.
policies.payment: Confirmed before work starts; refunded in full if the deliverable is rejected against the agreed acceptance criteria.
policies.review: A human reviews every triage decision and every deliverable before it ships.

services.deliverable: Reproduce the issue, identify the likely root cause, map affected files, write a scoped fix plan. No code change.
Everything in TRIAGE, plus: implement the fix, add a regression test, run the full test suite, open a documented PR.
Everything in FIX, plus: broader edge cases, docs updated, migration notes if needed, one revision round.
